outcome: duration of first stage of labor
duration of second stage of labor
cohort: The study included singleton pregnant women undergoing labor induction at a hospital between December 2020 and November 2021.
finding: Epidural analgesia significantly prolonged the second stage of labor by 19 minutes in multiparous women but had no effect in primiparous women, with no significant differences in other secondary outcomes.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed in the rates of instrumental delivery or cesarean section with epidural analgesia.
